text:
Rae (People Ops): Quick sync: we're publishing clarifications to the Flexible Time Off (FTO) handbook section to reduce manager confusion and to add an abuse-prevention workflow. Key changes: explicit examples of permitted use, soft cap guidance for salaried roles in certain countries, mandatory 15-min anti-bias microtraining for managers approving 5+ consecutive days, and e-sign acknowledgement for managers on the manager-side policy. Draft here: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/fto-clarifications-v1 :memo:

Tom (Payroll): For countries with statutory minimums (UK/DE) we need a mapping of how FTO interacts with statutory leave. Also need a payroll export flag for "manager_exception_approved" to handle pay treatment for extended ad-hoc leaves.

Alisha (Legal): We'll need the jurisdiction_scope callouts and a short paragraph describing when company policy defers to statutory rules. Also flag any collective bargaining/works council requirements; DE likely needs notice.

Vera (Managers): Quick ask: can we add a one-click checklist in the portal for managers to record rationale for exceptions (business impact, coverage plan)? Saves a lot of thread-based approvals.

Rae (People Ops): Absolutely. We'll add a rationale text field and a "coverage plan" checkbox list. Portal will capture manager_id and manager_exception_approved boolean. We'll surface this in the weekly export for audits.

compliance-bot: New requirement: managers who approve >10 days FTO in a 12-month rolling window will be auto-assigned the "FTO-approval-bias" microtraining.

i18n-team: We can localize the manager checklist and employee-facing examples once copy is final; estimate 4 business days for FR/DE/ES after freeze.

Tom (Payroll): Example export for auditing and payroll handoff:
```
# HR export - FTO approvals
python hr_exports.py --export fto_approvals --start 2026-06-01 --end 2026-06-30 --format csv > /tmp/fto_approvals_jun.csv

# BigQuery
SELECT employee_id, manager_id, start_date, end_date, days_approved, manager_exception_approved, exception_rationale, policy_version
FROM `redwood-hr.prod.fto_approvals`
WHERE start_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30';
```

Alisha (Legal): I'll add the DE works council note and a short disclaimer for APAC pilot differences. Will post suggested wording by Tue.

Vera (Managers): Please add a manager dashboard badge that surfaces pending manager e-signatures for the updated manager policy; we have too many outstanding acks from last rollout.

Rae (People Ops): Action list: 1) Alisha to deliver legal callouts by Tue. 2) Tom to include payroll flags in export by Fri and provide sample CSV. 3) Eng to add rationale and coverage_plan fields to portal (sprint planning). 4) i18n to prep translations after freeze. 5) People Ops to schedule two 30-min manager drop-ins (Americas/EMEA) next week to walk through new checklist and microtraining. We'll require manager e-signature within 21 days of publish; People Ops will run weekly missing-ack exports and nudge managers. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
